test_title: SSC CPO Tier-II Previous Year Paper (Held On: 26th July 2021)
subject: general
question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined idiom in the given sentence.**

The new CEO is in favour of giving plenty of __elbow room__ to the managers.

options.text: freedom to do what one wants

solution:
The correct answer is '**freedom to do what one wants**.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Given Idiom: *Elbow room* means **the freedom and ability to act as one wants**. (जैसा चाहे वैसा कार्य करने की स्वतंत्रता और क्षमता)

 
 
• *Example: I can hardly move. Give me some **elbow room***.
 
 
 
• From the given options, the third option is the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

 

Hence, the correct answer is option 3.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e085a7f17645c801966c030eb44d69fae944b96fdb4c4077f5fba1bc2c24bc71.png] **Mistake Points__**

__
 
• We may think from the phrase "Elbow room" that it is all about some type of room.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• 
 
 *This metaphor for having enough space to extend one’s elbows has been used since the sixteenth century*.
